Hi Emily — thanks for the PO and the clear questions. Looping in Marissa (finance) and Laura (billing) to confirm exact invoice slots and any PO language requirements. A couple of quick notes from product/ops perspective:

- Two-invoice cadence is fine in principle; we typically accept 50/50 split but final acceptance depends on the SOW milestone being marked complete.
- For bookings recognition in Q4, finance generally needs the invoice fully processed (received + PO reference) no later than 2026-12-28 23:59 PST. Invoices received after that will roll to next fiscal month recognition.

Proposed invoice dates to keep everything inside Q4 recognition window:
1) Initial invoice: on PO issuance (we can process immediately)
2) Final invoice: dated 2026-12-20, payment terms per PO

Marissa / Laura — can you confirm the cutoff above and whether Acme needs any specific invoice reference (e.g., deal id RDW-ACM-2047, SOW number) to avoid processing delays? Also please advise whether partial invoicing requires any special GL coding on our side so Emily can include it in the PO.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com

Karthik / team — finance confirms the processing rules and recommends the schedule below to ensure Q4 bookings recognition. I've attached a simple slotting spreadsheet (Invoice-slotting-proposal.xlsx) with the proposed dates and required invoice fields. Key points: 

- Cutoff for Q4 recognition: invoices must be received AND entered into our AR system by 2026-12-28 23:59 PST. That means email with invoice PDF + correct PO reference AND billing contact info.
- Required invoice fields to avoid manual hold: PO number, deal id (RDW-ACM-2047), SOW number, billing contact name/email, and itemized line for "Redwood Inference: Dedicated Capacity (Dec 2026)".
- Two-invoice cadence acceptable: initial (50%) on PO issue, final (50%) on SOW acceptance. If Acme prefers a single invoice, it must be dated and received by the same cutoff.
- If the final invoice is dated after 12/28 but delivered earlier, we will still need to process against the date on the invoice — so date control is important.

Proposed definitive schedule we can commit to:
- Day 0 (PO issued): Acme sends initial invoice (50%) — we'll process within 3 business days.
- 2026-12-20: Acme sends final invoice (50%) dated 12/20 to guarantee Q4 recognition.

I'll also note that if Acme needs Redwood to accept an EDI-style reference or a different GL line, please flag it now. Rishi — help on exceptions if Acme requests a different split.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
